name: mnemos
description: Your memory and skills for Claude, stored on this computer, one context at a time.
long_description: Runs Mnemos in local mode: notes in SQLite under your Mnemos folder, no Docker, no account. Each install of this extension serves one context (e.g. personal); other contexts are not visible to it. Claude is told to treat it as its own long-term memory: it searches Mnemos at the start of each conversation and saves durable facts you share (preferences, decisions, people, projects) without being asked.

home.title: Mnemos folder
home.description: Where your notes and skills live (created if empty).

context.title: Context
context.description: Which context Claude uses here (e.g. personal, work).

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Search your memory. Claude calls it at the start of each conversation with the topic at hand.

tools.name: memory_save
tools.description: Remember a durable fact you shared (preference, decision, person, project). Never secrets.

tools.name: memory_list
tools.description: List saved notes (to find one to fix).

tools.name: memory_update
tools.description: Correct a note that changed instead of duplicating it.

tools.name: skills_get
tools.description: Read a skill and follow it.
